RedWallet iOS diagnostic update.

CoinJoin remains experimental. This build adds specific coin, backend, validation and pool-rejection diagnostics, shows failed validation distinctly from waiting, and preserves coin reservations and every signing guard. It also handles a reported-tip race and distinguishes incomplete backend responses.

A completed live CoinJoin pool has not yet been verified on the physical iPhone. These diagnostics do not establish that the underlying live-pool issue is resolved. Stop participation is available for an unsigned attempt as described in the app. Please keep recovery backups secure.

Other wallet features include XBT Taproot/native SegWit accounts, recovery discovery, receive/share QR, encrypted wallet storage and reviewed fee replacement.
